input: Find a reputable pet groomer near my home

gold.taskTitle: Find a Reputable Pet Groomer Near Home
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to locate and choose a trustworthy, nearby pet groomer for their pet.

questions.title: What type and breed is your pet?
questions.description: Knowing the species and breed helps identify groomers with the right expertise and equipment.

questions.title: What is your home zip code or neighborhood?
questions.description: A specific location is needed to search for groomers within a practical distance.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel for grooming?
questions.description: Defines the search radius, such as within 2 miles, 5 miles, or 10 miles.

questions.title: What specific grooming services does your pet need?
questions.description: Services can range from a basic bath and trim to full grooming, nail clipping, teeth brushing, or breed-specific styling.

questions.title: Do you prefer mobile grooming or a salon visit?
questions.description: Some owners prefer the convenience of a groomer who comes to the home versus dropping the pet off at a shop.

questions.title: What is your budget per grooming session?
questions.description: A price range helps filter out groomers that are too expensive or may signal low quality.

questions.title: Does your pet have any health, behavioral, or anxiety issues?
questions.description: Special needs such as aggression, senior age, skin conditions, or fear of grooming may require a groomer with specific experience.
